meta.title: Hide sidebar Plugins row and built-in presets
meta.description: Removes the Plugins row from the left sidebar and hides the built-in agent presets (Standard, PTC, Minimal, Creator) from the new-session preset chip, Settings > Agent presets, and the preset roster. Custom presets stay visible. Creator mode is hidden by default too. To reach the Plugins page afterwards, use the sidebar panel list's More button, then Browse other plugins.
